item.title: Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) for Tariffs and Supply Chains: Pathways to Resilient Economic Planning
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on applying multi-criteria decision analysis methodologies to address challenges related to tariffs and supply chain management. The collection seeks research that demonstrates how MCDA frameworks can inform more resilient approaches to economic planning in increasingly complex and interconnected global markets.

Appel publié par Socio-Economic Planning Sciences. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
